## Abstract

The WegenerNet 3D Open-Air Laboratory GNSS StarNet stations are strategically distributed within the Feldbach region's climate station network. Each GNSS StarNet station is co-located with a climate station to provide high-quality surface meteorological observations and robust integrated water vapor retrieval. The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences performs near real-time processing of GNSS StarNet L0 data into tropospheric data variables.

All data products generated in the WegenerNet 3D Open-Air Laboratory are publicly available under a CC BY 4.0 license.

Level 0 (L0) data are unchecked raw data in their native file formats generated by sensor software or data loggers. No post-processing steps are applied to L0 data; thus, they are preserved in the state in which they are retrieved from different sources.
